session_token.description: Compact EdDSA JWS; send verbatim as X-Autocomplete-Session.

expires_in.description: Seconds until the tier stops honouring the grant; refresh at about 80 %.

expires_at.description: The same instant as a UTC timestamp (the token's exp), for display and logs; time refreshes from expires_in. Optional here so a body from an API that predates it still parses.

filter_min_stem.description: Characters of q the narrowing filters wait for.
